title: connectivity
body:
## connectivity

Labels the connected regions of the input (cells linked through shared points) and keeps all regions, the largest one (most cells) or the one closest to a point; output is an unstructured grid. With colourRegions (Schemaxis default true) a RegionId array identifies each region. Use it to separate disjoint bodies, drop small fragments or isolate the part near a location.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Connectivity is topological: parts that touch only geometrically, with duplicate points, count as separate regions; run clean or cleanGrid first.

Native constructor: `Connectivity`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | Controls the extraction of connected surfaces. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Extract All Regions","Extract Largest Region","Extract Closest Point Region"]}` | `"Extract All Regions"` | `"Extract All Regions"` |
| `colourRegions` | Controls the coloring of the connected regions. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `closestPoint` | Specifies the point to use in closest point mode. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` | `[0,0,0]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "connectivity",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
